        <script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
	if(gs.getProperty('x_onpr_onpage.send_method')=="batch"){
		var log = new x_onpr_onpage.log();
		log.info("Message sending set to batch.","outbound",current.getTableName(),current.getUniqueValue());
	}
	else{
		var id = current.getUniqueValue();
		current.setValue('status',"sending");
		current.update();
		var //doc = current.getValue('document_id'),
			doc = current.getUniqueValue(),
			sd = current.getValue('short_description'),
			body = current.getValue('body'),
			recip = current.getValue('recipients').split(","),
			priority = current.getValue('priority'),
			options = current.getValue('reply_options'),
			reply = '';
			if(options!=''&&options!=null){
				reply = options.split(",");
			}
		var resp = new x_onpr_onpage.workflow().sendRestMessage(doc,sd,body,recip,priority,reply,id);
		var ans = resp.split(';'),
			status = ans[0];
		if(status=="error"){
			current.setValue('error',ans[1]);
		}
		else if(status=="sent"){
			//current.setValue('onpage_id',ans[1]);
		}
		current.setValue('status',status);
		current.update();
	}
})(current, previous);
]]></script>
